'''Parella's starship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco]]. At some point, the Hutt used the ship to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]] to hunt down a surviving member of the legendary [[Gorach]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
